targetTexts.1: Dishonest scales are an abomination to the LORD, but an accurate weight is His delight.
targetTexts.2: When pride comes, disgrace follows, but with humility comes wisdom.
targetTexts.3: The integrity of the upright guides them, but the perversity of the faithless destroys them.
targetTexts.4: Riches are worthless in the day of wrath, but righteousness brings deliverance from death.
targetTexts.5: The righteousness of the blameless directs their path, but the wicked fall by their own wickedness.
targetTexts.6: The righteousness of the upright delivers them, but the faithless are trapped by their own desires.
targetTexts.7: When the wicked man dies, his hope perishes, and the hope of his strength vanishes.
targetTexts.8: The righteous man is delivered from trouble; in his place the wicked man goes in.
targetTexts.9: With his mouth the ungodly man destroys his neighbor, but through knowledge the righteous are rescued.
targetTexts.10: When the righteous thrive, the city rejoices, and when the wicked perish, there are shouts of joy.
targetTexts.11: By the blessing of the upright a city is built up, but by the mouth of the wicked it is torn down.
targetTexts.12: Whoever shows contempt for his neighbor lacks judgment, but a man of understanding remains silent.
targetTexts.13: A gossip reveals a secret, but a trustworthy person keeps a confidence.
targetTexts.14: For lack of guidance, a nation falls, but with many counselors comes deliverance.
targetTexts.15: He who puts up security for a stranger will surely suffer, but the one who hates indebtedness is secure.
targetTexts.16: A gracious woman attains honor, but ruthless men gain only wealth.
targetTexts.17: A kind man benefits himself, but a cruel man brings trouble on himself.
targetTexts.18: The wicked man earns an empty wage, but he who sows righteousness reaps a true reward.
targetTexts.19: Genuine righteousness leads to life, but the pursuit of evil brings death.
targetTexts.20: The perverse in heart are an abomination to the LORD, but the blameless in their walk are His delight.
targetTexts.21: Be assured that the wicked will not go unpunished, but the offspring of the righteous will escape.
targetTexts.22: Like a gold ring in a pig’s snout is a beautiful woman who lacks discretion.
targetTexts.23: The desire of the righteous leads only to good, but the hope of the wicked brings wrath.
targetTexts.24: One gives freely, yet gains even more; another withholds what is right, only to become poor.
targetTexts.25: A generous soul will prosper, and he who refreshes others will himself be refreshed.
targetTexts.26: The people will curse the hoarder of grain, but blessing will crown the one who sells it.
targetTexts.27: He who searches out good finds favor, but evil will come to him who seeks it.
targetTexts.28: He who trusts in his riches will fall, but the righteous will thrive like foliage.
targetTexts.29: He who brings trouble on his house will inherit the wind, and the fool will be servant to the wise of heart.
targetTexts.30: The fruit of the righteous is a tree of life, and he who wins souls is wise.
targetTexts.31: If the righteous receive their due on earth, how much more the ungodly and the sinner!
